# Dataset schema

Schema version **1.0.0**, produced by cleaning version **1.0.0**. One row per transaction row in a source filing.

* Money and quantities are exact decimals, never floating point.
* Booleans are three-state where noted: `true`, `false`, or `null` meaning unknown.
* Every column is nullable unless its description says otherwise; a null always means the source did not provide the value, never that one was dropped.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `transaction_id` | string | Stable identifier: 'f4c_' plus the first 20 hex characters of SHA-256 over source_transaction_id. Unchanged when the same filing is processed again. |
| `source_transaction_id` | string | Position of the record in its source filing: '{accession}:{ND\|D}:{sequence}' (ND = Table I non-derivative, D = Table II derivative, sequence is 0-based). |
| `accession_number` | string | SEC accession number of the filing, e.g. 0001197647-26-000011. |
| `form_type` | string | Form type from the filing header: '4' or '4/A'. |
| `transaction_table` | string | 'non_derivative' (Table I) or 'derivative' (Table II). |
| `sequence` | integer | 0-based position among transactions in its table. |
| `company_cik` | string | Issuer CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros. |
| `ticker` | string | Ticker of the company the dataset was built for, from SEC's ticker file. Null if the company has no current ticker. |
| `company_name` | string | Issuer name as reported in the filing. |
| `issuer_trading_symbol` | string | Trading symbol exactly as reported in the filing, which may differ from the current ticker. |
| `insider_cik` | string | CIK of the first reporting owner, 10 digits. |
| `insider_name` | string | Display name of the first reporting owner. Individuals reported as 'LAST FIRST' are reordered to 'First Last'; entity names keep their order. See insider_name_raw. |
| `insider_name_raw` | string | Reporting owner name exactly as filed. |
| `insider_role` | string | Primary standardized role: CEO, CFO, COO, President, Chair, General Counsel, CTO, CAO, Officer, Director, 10% Owner, Other or Unknown. |
| `is_director` | boolean | Reporting owner relationship box: director. |
| `is_officer` | boolean | Reporting owner relationship box: officer. |
| `is_ten_percent_owner` | boolean | Reporting owner relationship box: 10% owner. |
| `is_other_reporting_owner` | boolean | Reporting owner relationship box: other. |
| `officer_title` | string | Officer title as filed, whitespace-normalized. |
| `other_relationship_text` | string | Text describing an 'other' relationship. |
| `reporting_owners` | list of {cik, name} | All reporting owners on the filing. Joint filings report one set of transactions for several owners; the record is kept once, not once per owner, so shares are not double-counted. |
| `reporting_owner_count` | integer | Number of reporting owners on the filing. |
| `transaction_date` | date | Date the transaction was executed. |
| `deemed_execution_date` | date | Deemed execution date, if reported. |
| `filing_date` | date | SEC filing date from the header. Filings accepted after 5:30 p.m. Eastern receive the next business day's filing date. |
| `filing_timestamp` | timestamp (America/New_York) | Time the SEC accepted the filing (US Eastern, timezone-aware), from the filing header's ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME. This is when the information became public. |
| `disclosure_timing` | string | When the filing was accepted relative to regular NYSE hours: PRE_MARKET, MARKET_HOURS, AFTER_CLOSE, NON_TRADING_DAY or UNKNOWN. |
| `disclosure_session_date` | date | First regular trading session during which the filing was public: the same day if accepted before the close of a trading day, otherwise the next trading day. |
| `days_to_file` | integer | Calendar days from transaction_date to filing_date. |
| `transaction_code` | string | SEC transaction code exactly as filed (e.g. P, S, M). |
| `transaction_type` | string | Plain-language description of the transaction code. |
| `transaction_category` | string | Standardized category. See docs/classification.md. |
| `transaction_direction` | string | ACQUISITION or DISPOSITION, from the acquired/disposed code (A/D), or UNKNOWN. |
| `acquired_disposed_code` | string | Acquired (A) / disposed (D) code as filed. |
| `equity_swap_involved` | boolean | Equity swap box as filed. |
| `shares` | decimal(38, 10) | Number of securities in the transaction. For derivative rows, the number of derivative securities. Exact decimal. |
| `price_per_share` | decimal(38, 10) | Price per security as filed. Null when the filing gives no price. Often a weighted average; see footnotes. |
| `transaction_value` | decimal(38, 2) | shares x price_per_share, rounded half-up to cents. Null when either is missing or the price is zero (gifts and awards have no market value at a zero price). |
| `shares_owned_after` | decimal(38, 10) | Securities owned following the transaction. |
| `security_title` | string | Security title after normalization rules. |
| `security_title_raw` | string | Security title exactly as filed. |
| `is_derivative` | boolean | True for Table II (derivative) rows. |
| `underlying_security_title` | string | Derivative rows: underlying security title. |
| `underlying_shares` | decimal(38, 10) | Derivative rows: number of underlying securities. |
| `exercise_price` | decimal(38, 10) | Derivative rows: conversion or exercise price. |
| `exercise_date` | date | Derivative rows: date exercisable. |
| `expiration_date` | date | Derivative rows: expiration date. |
| `ownership_type` | string | 'Direct' or 'Indirect', from the D/I code. Null if absent. |
| `ownership_nature` | string | Nature of indirect ownership as filed, e.g. 'By Trust'. |
| `is_market_transaction` | boolean | Whether the trade was executed in the open market. Null for P and S codes unless a footnote says open market or private; false for all other codes. |
| `is_discretionary_trade` | boolean | Whether the insider chose the timing of the trade. False for awards, exercises, tax withholding and 10b5-1 plan trades; null when it cannot be determined. |
| `is_10b5_1` | boolean | Whether the trade was made under a Rule 10b5-1 plan. From the filing's 10b5-1 checkbox (forms since April 2023) or a footnote; null when unknown. |
| `is_10b5_1_source` | string | 'checkbox', 'footnote', or null. |
| `classification_confidence` | string | HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW. |
| `classification_reason` | string | Why the record was classified this way. |
| `is_amended` | boolean | True when this record comes from an amendment (Form 4/A). |
| `amendment_status` | string | Reconciliation outcome. See docs/amendments.md. |
| `amends_accession_number` | string | For amendment records: accession number of the filing it was reconciled against. |
| `superseded_by` | string | transaction_id of the record that replaced this one. |
| `is_current` | boolean | True when the record belongs to the current view (not superseded, not ambiguous). |
| `quality_status` | string | VALID, WARNING, REVIEW_REQUIRED or INVALID. |
| `quality_flags` | list of string | Codes of every quality check that fired, including INFO. |
| `quality_explanations` | list of string | Plain-language explanation for each flag, same order. |
| `footnotes` | list of {id, fields, text} | Footnotes referenced by this record, with the fields that reference them. |
| `related_transaction_ids` | list of string | Records that are probably part of the same economic event: the two legs of an option exercise, or the same trade reported by several joint filers. |
| `sec_filing_url` | string | Link to the filing index on sec.gov. |
| `source_document` | string | File name of the ownership XML within the filing. |
| `source_values` | string | JSON object of the original source strings for this record. |
| `cleaning_version` | string | Version of the cleaning rules that produced the record. |
| `schema_version` | string | Version of this schema. |
